node.statement: Since q_t>=0 and sum_t q_t=1 by lem-kitaev-diagonal-repair, subtract tilde-Delta_n(X)=sum_t q_t tilde-Delta_n(X) from the formula in 1.3.1 and use the triangle inequality with 1.3.3 and 1.3.4. This gives ||Delta_prime_n(X)-tilde-Delta_n(X)|| <= sum_t q_t*(4*C_theta+C_T)*eta*||X||=(C_T+4*C_theta)*eta*||X||.
